caption: How to get off the floor without using your hands: four rungs with the full movement name, the tier, the reps and the exact test that says you are ready for the next one. Supported Sit-to-Stand, Sit-to-Stand, Paused Squat, Elevated Split Squat, then Single-Leg Sit-to-Stand at the top. Getting down on the floor with her is free. Getting up is the training. Save the ladder.

overlays.text: Do this every day and getting off the floor stops being a thing.

scenes.footer: Ready for rung 2 when you barely need your hands.

overlays.text: Supported Sit-to-Stand. 8 reps. Hands on the chair, stand up, sit down slowly.
Sit-to-Stand. 8 reps. Arms folded, stand up, sit down slowly.

scenes.footer: Ready when the pause is steady.

overlays.text: Paused Squat. 8 reps. Squat down, hold for two seconds, stand up.
Elevated Split Squat. 6 each side. Back foot on the chair, lower, stand up.

scenes.footer: This is getting up off the floor.

overlays.text: Single-Leg Sit-to-Stand. 4 reps. One leg, no hands, off the chair.
Rung four takes months, not a week.
